GOLD DROPS TO $3,588.20 HITTING 14‑MONTH LOW

On 20 November 2026, spot gold fell to $3,607.47 per ounce, a 0.4% drop, while the price slipped further to $3,588.20 per ounce, a 14‑month low.
The fall was linked to a stronger US dollar and growing expectations of a Federal Reserve rate increase in December, factors that can affect Indian market sentiment and gold‑linked investments.

For information only. Not investment advice.
